Delicious.

Just kidding, it's awful. I didn't know it was for petmunk, so I thought I would have a sample. BIG. MISTAKE. If its cubic shape wasn't enough to throw you off, it is grey, smelly, and cold. I have no idea why I ate it. Maybe I'm protein deficient. |destination = 1400,

}} {{ItemLink|{{PAGENAME}}|displayName=false}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[:Category:Common_Items|{{color|common|common}}]] [[:Category:Damage_Items|{{color|inyellow|damage}}]] item that spawns an area of blue fire on the ground below slain enemies, functioning similarly to the fire trails spawned by {{Elite|Blazing}} elites. {{ItemShippingDetails |number = 1477 |story = Gasoline, eh? Old Lincoln |priority = Standard |date = 02/25/2056 }} ==Tips & Notes== *Unlike the usual fire trails, '''Gasoline''' fire can stack ontop of each other and therefore deal more damage. == Associated Challenges == {|class="wikitable sortable" {{ChallengeTableRow|Lizard Bait}} |} {{Navbox}}

[[category:Common Items]][[category:Utility Items]][[category:Items]]{{ItemInfobox |image = [[File:Backupmagazine.png]] |description = Add {{color|extra|+1}} {{color|c_stack|(+1 per stack)}} charge of your {{color|extra|Secondary skill}}. |tier = [[Items#White/Common|{{color|common|Common}}]] |category = [https://riskofrainreturns.wiki.gg/wiki/Category:Utility_Items Utility] |unlock = Unlocked by default. }} The {{ItemLink|{{PAGENAME}}|displayName=false}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Items#White/Common|{{color|common|common}}]] [[:Category:Utility_Items|{{color|inutility|utility}}]] item that adds additional maximum stocks to the player's secondary skill. {{ItemShippingDetails |number = 177 |story = It's not much, but our damaged spares in the back of the warehouse should be better than nothing. I'm really putting myself in a bad spot doing this outside of regulations, but the treaties make it tough to send out the good stuff. I can't let my buddies just die out there because of some big-wigs who are afraid to get the job done.
Give em a few smacks before loading and fire a shot or two inside before trusting the mags. Good luck out there. At least we haven't seen any restrictions on the meds. |destination = 1803
Combat Zone
Venus |priority = High Priority |date = 9/12/2056 }} == Tips & Notes == * Stocks allow for extra uses of the skill immediately after using it, and charge one by one. Cooldown does not reduce. * Due to its low cooldown and fast damage, extra stocks are desirable for {{SurvivorLink|Mercenary|altText=Mercenary's}} {{SkillLink|Whirlwind}}. * This item can help with completing {{SurvivorLink|Engineer|altText=Engineer's}} {{color|inyellow|Controlled Demolition}} challenge (Detonate 15 {{SkillLink|Bounding Mine}} within 5 seconds). * {{SurvivorLink|Huntress|altText=Huntresses}} {{SkillLink|Laser Cyclone}} pauses its cooldown while any are active so all must be returned to be able to let them recharge. == Trivia == * This item has the same delivery address as {{ItemLink|Soldier's Syringe}}. * This is a returning item from Risk of Rain 2. As such, it did not appear in the original 2013 game. * Similarly to {{ItemLink|Mocha}}, its shipping method is listed as High Priority rather than Standard that most white items use. However, it is not colored red. {{Navbox}}

[[category:Common Items]][[category:Damage Items]][[category:Items]]{{ItemInfobox |image = [[File:Fireshield.png]] |description = After taking more than {{color|r|10% of your health}} as damage, explode for {{color|d|400%}} {{color|c_stack|(+200% per stack) }}{{color|d|damage}}, {{color|extra|knocking enemies away}} {{color|c_stack|(+20% force per stack)}}. |tier = [[Items#White/Common|{{color|common|Common}}]] |category = [https://riskofrainreturns.wiki.gg/wiki/Category:Damage_Items {{color|d|Damage}}] |unlock = Unlocked by default. }} The {{ItemLink|{{PAGENAME}}|displayName=false}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[:Category:Common_Items|{{color|common|common}}]] [[:Category:Damage_Items|{{color|d|damage}}]] item that produces a explosion after taking a large amount of damage, knocking enemies away. {{ItemShippingDetails |number = 1512 |story = The thing is only half-done, but it will do the job. The flux-chains are very unstable, resulting in a large explosion when struck. PLEASE handle with care! |destination = Soloman
-
Backwaters
Mars |priority = Standard |date = 6/06/2056 }} == Tips & Notes == * The damage inflicted by this item can trigger on-hit effects. * {{SurvivorLink|Engineer}}'s Turrets—especially his {{SkillLink|V.0.2 Prototype Laser Turret}}—can benefit immensely from this item, as they cannot move and therefore cannot attempt to prevent further damage. * Ranged survivors can benefit from this item more than melee survivors, due to their need for distance, but it is generally less challenging for melee to proc it numerous times due to their tanky status, especially {{SurvivorLink|HAN-D}}. * {{SurvivorLink|Miner}}'s {{SkillLink|Burnout}} can be used to trigger this item on command. {{color|c_stack|(Note: Needs verification)}} === Trivia === * This item has the same delivery address and recipient as {{ItemLink|Alien Head}}. {{Navbox}}

[[category:Common Items]][[category:Healing Items]][[category:Items]]{{ItemInfobox |image = [[File:Bustlingfungus.png]] |description = After standing still for 2 seconds, {{color|g|heal}} for {{color|g|4.5%}} {{color|c_stack|(+4.5% per stack)}} of your {{color|g|health}} every second to yourself and nearby allies. |tier = [[Items#White/Common|{{color|common|Common}}]] |category = [https://riskofrainreturns.wiki.gg/wiki/Category:Healing_Items {{color|g|Healing}}] |unlock = Unlocked by default. }} {{ItemLink|{{PAGENAME}}|displayName=false}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Items#White/Common|{{color|common|common}}]] [[:Category:Damage_Items|{{color|inhealing|healing}}]] item that heals nearby players and allies after standing still for 2 seconds while not in combat. {{ItemShippingDetails |number = 1519 |story = The strongest biological healing agent.. is a mushroom. Found in an abandoned house. I find some humor in that.
This fungus has developed an amazing defense mechanism of hiding underground when bothered, allowing it to live long enough to distribute spores.

Can be either ground into a paste or.. planted directly into the wound. A small warning; you'll feel it enter you, and it is every bit as unpleasant as it sounds. |destination = 5243 22nd,
Rolling Fields,
Earth |priority = Standard |date = 11/9/1753 }} == Tips & Notes == * Even though not stated by the description, this item ceases to function when entering combat, even if standing still. * {{SurvivorLink|Engineer|altText=Engineer's}} turrets (both default and alternative skills) benefit from Bustling Fungus yet also cease to function when turrets shoot. * This item uses percentage-based healing rather than the usual flat healing. This means that it will remain at the same effectiveness throughout the game, rather than falling off later on. ** However, due to its nature, it becomes almost impossible to use later in runs. During early-game it can be your best friend. == Associated Challenges == {|class="wikitable sortable" {{ChallengeTableRow|Gourmet}} |} == Trivia == *This item is commonly referred to as "Bungus" by the community. {{Navbox}}

[[category:Common Items]][[category:Damage Items]][[category:Items]]{{ItemInfobox |image = [[File:Lensmakersglasses.png]] |description = Your attacks have an {{color|d|8%}} {{color|c_stack|(+8% per stack)}} chance to {{color|d|'Critically Strike'}}, dealing {{color|d|double damage}}. |tier = [[Items#White/Common|{{color|common|Common}}]] |category = [https://riskofrainreturns.wiki.gg/wiki/Category:Damage_Items {{color|d|Damage}}] |unlock = Unlocked by default. }} {{ItemLink|Lens Maker's Glasses|displayName=false}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are a [[:Category:Common_Items|{{color|common|common}}]] [[:Category:Damage_Items|{{color|d|damage}}]] item that grants a chance to critically hit enemies for double damage. {{ItemShippingDetails |number = 1525 |story = Calibrated for high focal alignment. Should allow for the precision you were asking for. I must ask.. for what reasons do you need such glasses? Surely the Department of Science would provide them for you?

I can't think of a single.. scientific reason why you would want this. Have you been hired by [REDACTED]? If you're in trouble, you can always ask me for help. |destination = Greivenkamp
5th Houston St.
Prism Tower
Earth |priority = Standard |date = 4/29/2056 }} == Tips & Notes == * {{color|note|Editor's note:}} The in-game description of {{color|y|10%}} {{color|c_stack|(+7% per stack)}} {{color|y|critical chance}} is incorrect. *This item effectively caps at 13 stacks, as added critical hit chance above 100% has no effect. *This item pairs well with 'on-critical hit' items such as {{ItemLink|Harvester's Scythe}} and {{ItemLink|Wicked Ring}}, since it allows for their effects to be activated much more. === Trivia === *Unlike Risk of Rain 2, stacking this item grants an 8% chance to deal critical damage, while in Risk of Rain 2, stacking grants a 10% added chance. This means it takes an additional 3 stacks to reach full potential. *This item has the same delivery address and recipient as {{ItemLink|Gigantic Amethyst}}. {{Navbox}}

[[category:Common Items]][[category:Healing Items]][[category:Items]]{{ItemInfobox |image = [[File:Sproutingegg.png]] |description = After not being hit for 7 seconds, increase {{color|g|health regeneration}} by {{color|g|2.4}} {{color|c_stack|(+2.4 per stack) }}{{color|g|hp}} per second. |tier = [[Items#White/Common|{{color|common|Common}}]] |category = [https://riskofrainreturns.wiki.gg/wiki/Category:Healing_Items {{color|g|Healing}}] |unlock = Unlocked by default. }} The {{ItemLink|{{PAGENAME}}|displayName=false}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Items#White/Common|{{color|common|common}}]] [[:Category:Damage_Items|{{color|inhealing|healing}}]] item that increases health regeneration when out of danger. {{ItemShippingDetails |number = 1498 |story = This egg seems to be somewhere between hatching and dying. Leaving it undisturbed usually causes it to wiggle around a bit, maybe sticking a tendril out. Trying to remove it from its shell is greeted by the most horrible screetching!

I can't bring it to myself to cook it alive. I don't know what to do with it, so here you go; maybe it will hatch in a warmer climate like yours. As useless as he is, I have grown a bit fond of him. Please take care! |destination = Battle Creek
49017 Mars |priority = Standard |date = 09/17/2056 }} == Tips & Notes == * The {{SurvivorLink|Enforcer}} can make good use out of this item when using {{SkillLink|Protect and Serve}}. If standing against the wall, any damage from hits that do get past the shield will be reversed shortly afterwards. * Using well-time dodges with {{SurvivorLink|Mercenary}} can allow for extended use of this item in combat. * It takes 7 seconds of taking no damage to be considered "out of danger". == Associated Challenges == {|class="wikitable sortable" {{ChallengeTableRow|Gourmet}} |} {{Navbox}}

[[category:Common Items]][[category:Damage Items]][[category:Items]]{{ItemInfobox |image = [[File:Headstompers.png]] |description = Hurt enemies by falling for up to {{color|d|600%}} {{color|c_stack|(+300% per stack) }}{{color|d|damage}}. |tier = [[Items#White/Common|{{color|common|Common}}]] |category = [https://riskofrainreturns.wiki.gg/wiki/Category:Damage_Items {{color|d|Damage}}] |unlock = Unlocked by default. }} The {{ItemLink|{{PAGENAME}}|displayName=false}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are a [[Items#White/Common|{{color|common|common}}]] [[:Category:Damage_Items|{{color|inyellow|damage}}]] item that deals heavy damage to enemies that are fallen onto. {{ItemShippingDetails |number = 1488 |story = Have you found the kill-count of your shoes to be 0? Do you find that disturbing? So do we. Combat Ready Spikeshoes, lovingly nicknamed 'Headstompers,' allow you to get the drop on foes. Literally. Vertically.

Titanium-tipped spikes, along with steel soles, guarantee that landing on foes will result in the messiest recreation of old school video games that you have ever seen. NOTE: Spikes deploy only after reaching a certain vertical velocity. |destination = 200,
Maple Lane,
Mars |priority = Standard |date = 5/11/2005 }} == Tips & Notes == * As the order details suggest, the item effect can only activate after falling for a short period of time. On contact with a floor, damage is applied in a small AoE (similar in size to one stack of {{ItemLink|Barbed Wire}}) around the player. * {{SurvivorLink|Huntress}} has the easiest time activating this item numerous times without external help from other items, due to her high mobility. ** A well-placed {{SkillLink|Warp Dart}} against a wall or even ceiling can cause this item to deal massive damage. *** {{SurvivorLink|Loader|altText=Loader's}} {{SkillLink|Hydraulic Gauntlet}} can have a similar effect. * {{SurvivorLink|Miner|altText=Miner's}} {{SkillLink|To the Stars}}, due to its similar height gain to a {{ItemLink|Hopoo Feather}}, can activate the item effect. ** {{SurvivorLink|Pilot|altText=Pilot's}} {{SkillLink|Rapid Deployment}} also has a similar effect, but with a greater yield due to a greater height gain. Do note that the parachute must be disabled mid-flight, or the item will not trigger. * {{SurvivorLink|Pilot|altText=Pilot's}} {{SkillLink|Aerobatics}} can easily deal maximum damage depending on the stage. [[Magma Barracks]] is the best example of this, with its generally vertical layout. * A {{ItemLink|Medkit}} can lessen or even nullify the health penalty from this item. * Falling down from a great height with {{ItemLink|Fire Shield}} can activate its effect along with this item's, allowing for much higher damage potential. The same can be said when used with {{ItemLink|Panic Mines}} or {{ItemLink|Old Box}}, but only at a chance. * {{ItemLink|Rusty Jetpack|altText=Rusty Jetpacks}}, {{ItemLink|Hopoo Feather|altText=Hopoo Feathers}}, and especially {{ItemLink|Photon Jetpack|altText=Photon Jetpacks}}, can easily activate the item effect for a small general damage boost. * {{ItemLink|Crudely-Drawn Buddy}} can put plenty of enemies in one area for maximum damage potential with this item. ** It is only recommended to do this if you have {{ItemLink|Prophet's Cape}} or are using a character with a dodge, as this can quickly result in death. ** Since they behave in a similar way, {{SurvivorLink|Artificer|altText=Artificer's}} {{SkillLink|Frost Barrier}} and {{SurvivorLink|Drifter|altText=Drifter's}} {{SkillLink|Scrap Cube}} to a lesser extent can as well. == Trivia == * This item is a reference to the "Facestompers" weapon from the game [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MapleStory MapleStory]. ** The estimated delivery, 05/11/2005, is the date of the game's release in North America. * The "recreation of old school video games" mentioned in the shipping details is a reference to the Super Mario Bros. franchise. {{Navbox}}

The {{ItemLink|{{PAGENAME}}|displayName=false}} {{color|or|{{PAGENAME}}}} is a [[Items#Purple/Special|{{color|special|special}}]] [[Items#Orange/Equipment|{{color|equipment|equipment}}]] item. Its effect does pitiful damage and has a very long cooldown, making it virtually useless as an offensive option. It is primarily used as part of a [[Robomando#Strange_Battery_Quest|hidden sidequest]].

== Obtaining ==
The {{color|or|{{PAGENAME}}}} can be found on every variant of [[Temple of the Elders]] when playing on {{Difficulty|Drizzle}}. It can be found inside an interactable urn, which drops the item when prompted. The urn is typically located along the edges of the stage. It bears a plus-shaped symbol connected to two bracket-like shapes, differentiating it from similar urns.

== Tips & Notes ==
* It is recommended to have multiple {{ItemLink|Hopoo Feather|altText=Hopoo Feathers}} or {{ItemLink|Rusty Jetpack|altText=Rusty Jetpacks}} in order to access the urn.
* The urn will not appear if the player is using the [[Artifact of Sacrifice|{{color|note|Artifact of Sacrifice}}]].
